name: recovery_monitoring
title: Recovery monitoring
outcome: Poor recovery: a deterioration episode within 72 hours (modified NEWS2 of 7 or more, or a vital-sign danger rule, for 30 minutes or longer)

metrics.split: held-out test patients; 5-fold cross-validation by patient
metrics.platform_parity: the platform's inputs match Navya's training table to 6 decimal places; AUROC 0.989 through the platform's feature path on the training data (0.991 on her table)

trained_on: 263 patients of the shared training data (MIMIC-IV-demo discharge state and the synthetic 72-hour wearable streams), scored at 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 hours after discharge
limitations: The outcome is defined by the data generator's danger rules, not observed clinical events. Trained on the first 24 hours after discharge; the platform scores patients later than that, where the model treats them like a 24-hour patient. The high band is Navya's alert threshold (0.348); the medium band (0.2) was set on the platform.
source: Recovery Monitoring Score - Model Files/recovery_score_model (hand-over of 2026-10-14)
